'''Quantana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual from [[Lopor Station]] who made a career for himself as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to raise funds to cover medical bills for his extended family. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Quantana was available for hire in [[Feris City]].<ref name="BM" />
